goal:
Build an “Enterprise Customer Success” platform:
  - Core entities: accounts, contacts, contracts, health signals, playbooks, and renewal risks.
  - Workflows: onboarding playbooks with tasks + owners, risk escalation with SLA timers, and executive summaries.
  - Analytics: daily rollup of health scores, churn risk buckets, and trend charts.
  - UI: account list + filters, account detail with timeline, risk dashboard, and playbook execution view.
  - Permissions: owner + collaborator roles (read/write) with access checks on one critical route.
  - Tests: service unit tests for health rollups and risk escalation; one UI smoke test.
  Local/dev only (no cloud provisioning or CI/CD).
